title: SVG join card
summary: A 1200x630 card a contributor can attach to a post. Handle, points, project. No script.
spec:
Create sparefold/gtm/svgcard.py with render_svg_card(handle, points, project) -> str.

Contract, checked by projects/gtm/checks/check_gtm_003.py:
- Return an SVG document whose stripped text starts with <svg.
- Include width="1200" and height="630".
- Include the handle, the project name, and the decimal points as text.
- Escape XML metacharacters in handle and project. A handle of <script> must not produce the substring <script>.
- No <script and no href=.
- Light background, dark text.
- Do not edit the checker.
